slides.title: Do you pull back *when it's good?*
slides.sub: Notice the timing. It tells you more than the reason does.

slides.title: Look at the timing
slides.body: Think of the last time you went quiet, picked a fight, or got busy. What was going well right before it?

slides.title: Notice the reason you gave
slides.body: Too busy. Not sure. They did one small thing wrong. The reason may be real. Ask if it's the whole story.

slides.title: Find the feeling underneath
slides.body: Close can feel like a lot. Ask yourself: what did getting closer feel like, right before I stepped back?

slides.title: Next time, stay a little longer
slides.body: You don't have to fix the pattern. Just notice the urge to pull back, name it, and stay ten minutes more.
